scope: Three researched resort options for a Coachella Valley team retreat; not a complete market ranking or live availability feed.

options.name: The Ritz-Carlton, Rancho Mirage
options.fit: A leadership offsite where a private working session and full-service luxury hospitality matter.
facts: Official capacity chart lists a boardroom for 20 in conference layout.
The resort publishes indoor and outdoor meeting venues and event-planning services.
constraints: The 20-person figure applies to the boardroom's conference layout, not the entire resort. Larger groups need a different room configuration.
Off-property activities require transport; confirm accessibility, AV, privacy and the total contracted cost.

primary_sources.label: Official meeting spaces and capacity chart

options.name: Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort & Villas
options.fit: A team gathering with room blocks, breakout sessions and a broader resort activity program.
facts: Official meeting page lists 88,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor event space.
The resort offers room blocks, meeting coordinators, catering and team activities.
constraints: Meeting-space area does not establish the capacity of your chosen room or layout; obtain a group proposal.
This is a full-service leisure resort. Confirm a quiet, private meeting space rather than assuming exclusive use of the property.

primary_sources.label: Official meetings, room blocks and activities

options.name: Sensei Porcupine Creek
options.fit: A wellness-centered executive retreat with private meeting spaces and a deliberately intimate estate setting.
facts: Official groups page offers corporate retreats, private meeting spaces and estate buyouts.
Groups reserving 10 or more rooms require a buyout; the published buyout maximum is 48 guests.
constraints: The published 48-guest maximum is a buyout limit, not a meeting-room capacity. Confirm room mix and meeting layout with the property.
The FAQ states a two-night minimum. Ordinarily guests must be 18+, or 16+ accompanied by an adult; the groups page permits children of all ages during an estate buyout.
Confirm inclusions, setup charges and the required buyout directly; group pricing is not published here.

primary_sources.label: Official corporate retreats and buyout terms
